# Toonect

> Connects manga, manhwa, and manhua writers with artists — for free collaborations, commissions, or contracted work.

Toonect is a matchmaking platform for comic creators. Writers post story briefs describing their project, genre, and preferred art style; artists showcase portfolios and message writers directly. Toonect charges zero platform fees — writers and artists negotiate and agree on terms between themselves.

## Key pages
- `/browse` — browse artists and writers by style, availability, and work type
- `/projects` — open story briefs looking for an artist
- `/artists/{username}` — an artist's public profile and portfolio
- `/writers/{username}` — a writer's public profile and open projects

## Legal
- Terms of Service: /terms
- Privacy Policy: /privacy

## Stack
Next.js (App Router), Supabase (auth, database, storage, real-time messaging).
